title: Carlos Gimenez highlights legislative work for South Florida and addresses Cuba and Middle East issues
text:
← Back to the wire
Carlos Gimenez highlights legislative work for South Florida and addresses Cuba and Middle East issues
U.S. Congressman Carlos A. Gimenez posted updates on October 6-7, focusing on his legislative activities for South Florida as well as commentary on developments in Cuba and the Middle East.
Rep. Carlos A. Gimenez, U.S. Congressman representing Florida’s 28th district, shared a series of posts on his social media account highlighting legislative efforts for South Florida and addressing international political issues in Cuba and the Middle East.
On October 6, 2026, Gimenez posted about his ongoing work in Congress: "We’re working hard delivering results for South Florida & taking our community’s values to Capitol Hill! #FL28 "
Later that day, he addressed the situation in Cuba with a message referencing both Beijing and Cuban authorities: "#SOSCuba Estos esbirros creen que el régimen en Pekín los va a salvar de lo que les viene arriba. Muy equivocados están. La libertad de #Cuba es inevitable y nadie podrá contra la voluntad de todo un pueblo decidido a ser libre." (October 6, 2026).
On October 7, 2026, Gimenez commented on foreign policy matters involving Spain and the Middle East: "Mientras el President de la Generalitat financia los terroristas de Hamas, @orriolsderipoll valientemente apoya la alianza entre occidente y el pueblo israelí. En el Congreso de Estados Unidos, agradecemos aquellos que se oponen a la política desquiciada anti-semita."
Gimenez has represented Florida’s 28th district since replacing Debbie Mucarsel-Powell in 2021 and previously served in the Florida House of Representatives and on the Miami-Dade County Commission from 2005 to 2011. Born in Havana, Cuba in 1954 and now residing in Miami, Gimenez graduated from Barry University with a Bachelor of Public Administration degree in 1999.
